sentence_stem: Unless the tenant gives written notice at least sixty days in advance,
correct_completion: the lease will automatically renew for another twelve-month term.
full_sentence: Unless the tenant gives written notice at least sixty days in advance, the lease will automatically renew for another twelve-month term.
acceptable_variants: the agreement will be extended for a further year.
the contract rolls over into a new twelve-month period.

options.text: the lease will automatically renew for another twelve-month term.
so the tenant has already given written notice.
options.why_wrong: 'So' signals a consequence of a completed action, but 'unless' sets up a condition that has not yet been met.

options.text: the tenant may terminate the lease at any time without notice.
options.why_wrong: This contradicts the notice requirement that the stem establishes as the condition for ending the lease.

options.text: the landlord has agreed to waive the notice period in writing.
options.why_wrong: This introduces a new event not implied by the stem, so it does not complete the conditional result.

grammar_focus: Conditional clauses with 'unless' and a present-tense result describing a contractual consequence
explanation: 'Unless' introduces the condition that prevents the default outcome, so the main clause must state what happens automatically when that notice is not given.
translation: A menos que o locatário dê aviso por escrito com pelo menos sessenta dias de antecedência, o contrato de locação será renovado automaticamente por mais um período de doze meses.
